verdict.rationale: Salv documents automated clearance rules that auto-close alerts, with every auto-closed alert kept on the record as an audit trail. AI-Powered Insights explains its reasoning but stays advisory, leaving the decision to humans. An API endpoint can update alert status, which plausibly lets a user change an automated outcome. However, nothing explicitly documents reopening or overriding an auto-closed alert while keeping the original rule match and rationale attached. Missing for 10: explicit override/reopen of auto-closed decisions, documented preservation of the original rationale alongside the override, independent or hands-on corroboration.
